28Quick answers

Quick answers.

Six questions the brand team will ask, answered before the pitch.

01

When could it start?

The plan assumes a start on 16 November 2026, which puts Set 01 on the feed on Saturday 12 December.

02

Will every hotel post the same thing?

No. Each THE Park hotel films its own version of the series, and every other brand speaks in its own voice (P. 24). The best of every city runs on @theparkhotels.

03

What about music rights and drinks rules?

Bands play their own songs and sign a release, so the full set can run on YouTube. No drinks brands appear in frame.

04

How will we know it works?

We count saves, WhatsApp chats and tables booked from social, every week. The first readout is in the week of 22 February 2027, and a series that trails is replaced.

05

What do you need from us?

Thirty minutes with the brand team, a contact at each venue, tagged links in the booking engine, and a hotel for Room 1967.

06

What will it cost?

We bring a costed plan to the pitch, handle by handle.

Dates and measures as set out on the earlier pages.Page28/31

31Appendix

Every number, and where it came from.

01The Park today

Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Q1 FY27 results, Aug 2026: revenue ₹166.8 crore, up 8.1%; occupancy 92%; RevPAR about ₹6,858 (Investywise, ScanX). Food, beverage, nightlife and lifestyle dining about 43% of revenue: IDBI Capital result review, 19 Aug 2026. Flurys 111 stores: Q1 FY27 investor presentation. 42 hotels in 32 cities: Business Traveller, October 2026. 87 hotels by FY30, 45 under development: company investor material, Q1 FY27 and 2 Sep 2026 (Multibagg; filing to NSE).

02Channels

As linked from theparkhotels.com, October 2026: Instagram @theparkhotels, YouTube /theparkhotels, Facebook The Park Hotels, X @parkhotelsindia, LinkedIn The Park Hotels, Pinterest @theparkhotels. Spotify and WhatsApp are Mask360’s proposal.

03The brands

The Park Hotels corporate overview: five hotel brands, plus Flurys. Zone by The Park at launch: design-conscious and price-conscious (eHotelier). Ran Baas The Palace, Patiala: 35 suites, opened January 2025, Prix Versailles world’s most beautiful hotels 2025 (Robb Report India, Time Out).

04Park Street

The Park Kolkata opened in 1967 on Park Street, which gave the group its name (Hotel Designs, Entrepreneur India). Venues from THE Park Kolkata and THE Park New Delhi dining pages: Someplace Else, Tantra, Roxy, Agni, Aqua, Fire. THE Park Bangalore was designed by Terence Conran. “Anything but ordinary” has been the line since the 2013 rebrand (Travel Trends Today).

05The content

Flurys turns 100 in 2027 and opened a 24-hour café in Gurugram on 7 Aug 2026 (company announcement via Sahi). The Kolkata Christmas Festival on Park Street is co-organised by the Apeejay Surrendra Group (News Arena). Instagram’s profile grid shows posts at 3:4. Pillars, series, formats, cadence, sample posts, captions and the Reel are Mask360’s proposal.

06The references

Twenty clips from hotel and brand feeds, gathered by Mask360 for direction: The Savoy, Four Seasons (with The White Lotus), The Roseate, Bulgari, Rosewood, Amankila, Mama Shelter, Raffles Jaipur, The Hoxton with Lacoste, and five hotels whose names are not on screen. Brands are named only where the clip shows them. Mask360 did not make these clips.

07Mask360

Accounts, managed feeds and the Nexa Platinum Lounge result come from Mask360’s own records.
